title: Micro racing drone
prompt: Build a small racing drone: under 50 g, at least 8 minutes of flight time, parts under 120 euros.

title: 5 inch freestyle drone
prompt: Design a 5 inch freestyle FPV quadcopter on 4S that stays stable in a 4 m/s gust, under 650 g and under 300 euros.

title: Camera drone
prompt: Build a light drone that carries a 30 g action camera and flies at least 6 minutes, parts under 150 euros.

title: Robot gripper
prompt: Design a robot gripper that picks up a 200 g soda can, 66 mm wide, the gripper under 300 g and under 60 euros.

title: Phone stand
prompt: Build a phone stand for a 6.7 inch phone that does not tip when you tap the screen, under 150 g and 6 euros in parts.

title: USB-C desk lamp
prompt: Design a USB-C desk lamp with a 30 cm arm and a 5 W LED head that does not tip over, parts under 35 euros.

title: Desk fan
prompt: Design a small 5 V USB desk fan with a 120 mm rotor on a stand that stays put while it runs, parts under 25 euros.

title: Raspberry Pi 5 enclosure
prompt: Design an enclosure for a Raspberry Pi 5 with a 30 mm fan that keeps the board under 70 °C, under 120 g.

title: Plant-watering robot
prompt: Build a plant-watering robot with a 500 ml tank and a 5 V pump that runs a week on batteries and does not tip when full.

title: 2WD RC car
prompt: Build a 2WD RC car chassis with two geared motors that does not roll over in a 0.6 g turn, under 400 g.

title: Wall hook
prompt: Design a 3D-printed wall hook that holds a 5 kg backpack with less than 2 mm sag, mounted with two screws.

title: Cable organizer
prompt: Design a desk-edge cable organizer that holds five USB cables, clips onto a 25 mm desk, under 20 g and 2 euros.

title: Headphone stand
prompt: Design a headphone stand for 350 g over-ear headphones that does not tip when you hang them on it, under 10 euros.

title: Bike light mount
prompt: Design a handlebar mount for a 120 g bike light on a 31.8 mm bar that bends less than 1 mm on bumps.

title: Shelf bracket
prompt: Design a shelf bracket for a 200 mm deep shelf that carries 10 kg with less than 1.5 mm sag at the tip.

title: Pan-tilt camera mount
prompt: Build a pan-tilt mount for a 60 g webcam with two SG90 servos that have enough torque, under 20 euros.

title: Bluetooth speaker
prompt: Design a Bluetooth speaker enclosure for a 40 mm driver and a 2000 mAh battery that plays 8 hours, under 30 euros.

title: Weather station
prompt: Design an outdoor weather station enclosure for an ESP32 and a BME280 on a solar-charged battery with enough power headroom.

title: Pet feeder
prompt: Build an automatic pet feeder with a 1 litre hopper and a servo auger that turns 50 g portions and does not tip over.

title: Laptop stand
prompt: Design a foldable laptop stand that lifts a 2 kg laptop 15 cm with less than 2 mm flex and does not tip, under 15 euros.
